data.title: Cloud Provider IP Abuse for BPH Resale
data.description: Detect patterns consistent with legitimate cloud provider IP blocks being resold for BPH: unusual CNAME density (100+ domains per IP), diverse domain registrants sharing the same cloud IP range, and high abuse-report-to-domain ratios. Documents Funnull-pattern indicators (332K domains across 548 CNAMEs).

enrichment_required.source: IP reputation enrichment (abuse report ratio for IP range)
IP classification enrichment (cloud provider IP identification)

falsepositives: Legitimate CDN customers with high domain count
SaaS platforms hosting multiple customer domains
